Thanks for the context — tagging in from security. Two quick clarifications and proposals: 

- Pen-test scope OK. RedwoodSec is fine; our standard rules are: scope only customer-facing endpoints, test window must be agreed (we prefer off-peak PT hours), and we require a remediation SLA window (we propose 10 business days).

Monica, can you produce an initial package by 2027-06-08? If no, propose an alternative date.
